e: October 2026 attacks on Saudi Arabia airports.

The head of Yemen's internationally recognized Presidential Leadership Council (PLC), Rashad al-Alimi, formally announces the start of a full-scale military counteroffensive from Saudi Arabia to reclaim all remaining Houthi-controlled territories. The Saudi-led coalition promises to back the offensive.
Authorities announce that shrapnel from a downed Houthi ballistic ballistic missile wounded one individual in Ahad Rafidah.
The Houthis announce that they struck an Aramco facility in Riyadh using missiles and drones, a claim rejected by the Saudi-led coalition.
The Saudi coalition announce that they downed three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis at Khamis Mushait.

The Saudi-led coalition states that the Houthis struck a power station providing electricity to the Prophet's Mosque in Medina, one of Islam's holiest sites, causing one transformer to go out of service, ‌a claim denied by the group.
The Saudi-led coalition reports that they downed four Houthi drones and two ballistic missiles fired at Saudi Arabia.
A pilot stabs his colleague on Flydubai Flight 1073 operating from Dubai to Tel Aviv, prompting passenger intervention and an emergency landing in Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz Airport in Tabuk.
The Saudi-led coalition state that it had downed two missiles and two drones ‌fired by the Houthis at Khamis Mushait and Riyadh.
The Saudi-led coalition announces that it downed six ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis towards Taif and Yanbu.
The Houthis state that they struck "a sensitive target" in Riyadh and Aramco infrastructure in Yanbu.
French President Emmanuel Macron announces that the country will send soldiers to protect Saudi Arabia on a Red Sea oil route, as part of an accord with Riyadh.
In order to combat Houthi attacks, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announces that the Royal Air Force would provide air-to-air refueling for Saudi aircraft.

A fire erupts at a fuel storage depot at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. The Houthis state that they targeted "sensitive sites" in Riyadh and Aramco utilities in Yanbu. The Saudi-led coalition states it downed a Houthi ballistic missile launched at Riyadh.
An Italian Eurofighter Typhoon jet is damaged by the Houthis in Saudi Arabia after Italy announced that it will deploy warships to protect shipping through Bab al-Mandeb.
Saudi state TV reports that one person was killed and two others were wounded amidst a drone downing in Taif.
The US authorizes the sale of F-35 Lightning II Joint Strike Fighter jets to Saudi Arabia.
The Houthis announce that they targeted King Khalid Air Base and Aramco utilities in Yanbu.
The Saudi-led coalition announce that Houthi attacks wounded 13 civilians in Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif the day before.
The Saudi-led coalition state that they downed a Houthi drone south of Mecca. The Houthis deny the allegation.

Authorities declare that they discovered about 114 million tons (or approximately 110 million tons in some reports) of ore that contain rare earth and uranium concentrations at the Jabal Sayid operation in the Medina Province.
The Houthis announce that they struck King Khalid Air Base.
Two people are injured in a Houthi attack in Jazan Province.
The Houthis declare that they launched a missile and drone attack on Sharurah military base.
Authorities close the East-West Crude Oil Pipeline following a drone attack carried out from Iraqi territory.

September 2026 Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia: The Houthis launch missile and drone attacks on civilian, economic and military facilities in Abha, Jizan, Najran and Khamis Mushait, wounding 73 people, including women and children, and igniting fires at oil facilities and utilities in southern Saudi Arabia.
France and Saudi Arabia agree to build a $7 billion theme park in the vicinity of Paris.
The Houthis state they struck a vessel near Yanbu.
The Houthis state that they targeted Najran Regional Airport and an Aramco facility in Najran.
The Houthis fire drones towards an Aramco oil refinery in Jazan.
The Houthis launch drone strikes on an Aramco facility in Najran.
The Houthis announce that they launched drone strikes on the Aramco refinery in Jazan.
Saudi Arabia announce the beginning of the Red Sea defence coalition led by the country.
The Houthis state that they hit a Saudi Aramco refinery in Jizan.
A major fire at a factory in Riyadh kills 16 Bangladeshi migrant workers.
Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey sign a joint defense agreement.
A Houthi missile attack in Najran Province injures 11 civilians.
The Houthis claim to have struck a Saudi target in the vicinity of Najran Regional Airport.
The Houthis claim to have targeted a Saudi ship using ballistic missiles.
Saudi Arabia says it shot down UAVs fired from Iraq at oil facilities.
